subject: Request: formal SLO remediation & credit disposition for Nimbus Labs
messages:
From: Oliver Cheng <oliver@nimbus-labs.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: support@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sustained latency above SLO last week

Hi Kimberly,

We saw persistent 95th percentile latency spikes across the inference endpoints serving our production traffic during the window 2027-06-24 18:00 UTC to 2027-06-25 03:00 UTC. The impact was material — our throughput dropped while tail latency climbed above the contracted SLO (95th pctl > 1.2s) for ~6 hours. I attached the latency extract and the support ticket (support_ticket_1287.pdf, latency_metrics_q2.csv).

Impact summary:
- Customer-facing inference calls failed or timed out intermittently for our checkout flow.
- Estimated revenue at risk: ~3% of weekly bookings for our affected cluster.
- We've opened internal mitigation work but need an official remediation plan and a credit/offset proposal from Redwood as per SLO section of our contract.

Requested:
1) A remediation timeline and root-cause statement.
2) Proposed make-good (credit or billing offset) to reconcile the breach.
3) Any operational changes to prevent recurrence.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will own the remediation and a rough hour-by-hour breakdown of what happened?

Thanks,
Oliver Cheng
Site Reliability Lead
Nimbus Labs

Attachments: support_ticket_1287.pdf (PDF), latency_metrics_q2.csv (CSV)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Cheng <oliver@nimbus-labs.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, support@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sustained latency above SLO last week

Oliver —

Thanks for the data and the clear summary. I'm sorry Nimbus hit that window; this is not the experience we aim to provide. I've asked our infra team to prioritize the forensic logs and KV-cache traces for that UTC window. Preliminary read from support: there was a combination of a model variant rollout that increased average token generation time and an unexpected disk contention on the host pool serving your tenant.

Short-term next steps (we own these):
- Infra will deliver a root-cause note and hour-by-hour event timeline by EOD Monday (2027-07-05).
- We'll provide a mitigation checklist (config pins + rollback guidance) if you need to self-enforce while we stabilize.

On the customer remedy: we typically offer either a pro-rated credit tied to the impacted token volume or a 30-day free-service credit for incidents with sustained SLO violation. To be concrete, I've sketched a draft in proposed_credit_sheet.xlsx and attached it for your review — it includes two options and the back-of-envelope calculations.

Karthik and Marissa — can you review the draft and advise what approvals we need for (a) an automated one-month service credit scoped to Nimbus's prod tenancy, or (b) a $XX,XXX pro-rated billing credit? I want to present an authorized offer to Nimbus once we confirm the root cause.

Oliver — thanks again for the clear ticket. Expect the RCA Monday; I'll push the approved remedy the moment internal signoffs complete.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_credit_sheet.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Cheng <oliver@nimbus-labs.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sustained latency above SLO last week

Kimberly —

I've reviewed the proposed_credit_sheet.xlsx. Given the duration and customer impact, I would lean toward offering the 30-day service credit for speed (option A) with a fall-back pro-rated cash credit (option B) if legal/finance push back. Rationale: quick mitigation reduces churn risk and demonstrates good-faith.

If we go option A, we can approve up to a single free-month allocation under delegated authority (per our internal concession policy) — anything beyond that needs VP-level signoff. Marissa, please confirm delegated approval threshold and whether Finance needs a journal entry template before we issue the credit.

Karthik
Director, Account Strategy

On a side note: please loop Legal only if Nimbus requests contract language changes; otherwise we can handle operational remediation and credit via amendment note and billing memo.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Cheng <oliver@nimbus-labs.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Formal approval request: Nimbus SLO remedy & proposed credit (DL-7842)

Marissa / Karthik —

Per the thread and the RCA (attached as a Drive link), infra confirmed the two contributing factors and mitigations completed on 2027-07-04: a rollback of the model variant and host pool rebalancing. Nimbus has validated performance returned to SLO.

Proposal to resolve:
- Offer option A: one-month service credit applied to Nimbus's prod tenancy (fast turn, minimal billing ops).
- Offer option B: a pro-rated billing credit of $12,450 reflecting the impacted token volume (requested if they prefer cash-equivalent).

Requested approvals:
- Marissa: confirm Finance is OK to apply option A under delegated concession authority and provide GL/journal entry guidance.
- Karthik: confirm we proceed with option A as the default; escalate to VP only if Nimbus asks for >1 month.

Related items: HubSpot deal DL-7842 holds the renewal scheduled for 2028-02; issuing this credit will not change the renewal economics but should be documented in the account notes (link below). DocuSign link for an amendment is prepared if Nimbus needs formal signature.

Links: RCA: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNimbusSLODocs
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/DEAL-7842
DocuSign (amendment ready): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-NIMBUS

Marissa — if you confirm by EOD today I will ship the offer to Oliver and trigger the credit application.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
